Hello, exorcists.

We begin the new decade deep in our technologies - are we possessed by daemons to complete our tasks? We cannot say. Perhaps an exorcist will be knocking on our doors soon...

[h3]D̷̡̍̋̚e̵̪̣̪͑͂͘ṽ̸̫̝̤̏͠ȩ̶͍͛̆l̶̻͈̱̹̈́̑͝o̴̼̊p̸̛̓̉͘ͅm̵̰͇̼̔̎͗͊e̸̹̱͑ņ̸̣̻̏̒́́ṭ̴̞̤̊͗̈́̔ͅ[/h3]
Much of the game's story arc has been completed, and the cases are all undergoing a polish round. Soon you will discover the mysteries of Ein Soph... unless, of course, you fall under possession yourself. Luckily, the technology has been updated in order to allow you to save and load cases across the game, with large improvements to the user interface so that there is more of a focus on the mystery solving. Along with new animations and 3D production on the final case, the Church's completion draws ever closer... Of course, we have also done the ritual exorcism to rid of as many bugs as possible.

This is a very work-in-progress example of the means in which your accusations will be articulated, after a suspect questions you about your accusation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/1b7e7c305b020357157579b4e87a78b7dbe6bcb5.png[/img]

Practice your skills, exorcist. We do not want any false truths...

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/543301709?t=03h30m20s]You may view the recording here[/url], on the digital sphere of Twitch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/937964f6fbe029bcf68eaa677f3aeac286fca3fb.gif[/img]

If not, we shall connect in the digital sphere of [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Discord[/url] or [url=http://www.twitter.com/kitfoxgames]Twitter[/url]. Or if you prefer electronic correspondence, via [url=http://www.kitfoxgames.com/sendy/kitfox-subscribe]newsletter[/url].

Praise,
Inquisitor Victoria and the Church of Kitfox

notes.title: Welcome, exorcists.
notes.content:
I, Victoria, am your humble servant and guide in this New World. As a part of the Church of Ain Soph's Inquisition, we depend on our exorcists to purge those who are infected. 

I will strive to keep you updated on the progress of this game, but cannot promise I myself will not be possessed by daemons.

[h1]Our development.[/h1]
Trust that these reports contain no lies - no daemons have infiltrated these hallowed servers... yet.

Let us first remind you of your role. In this New World, you are a digital exorcist. A unique timeline skill you have obtained shows a suspect's subjective retelling of the events. Use this to find contradictions, find the possessed, and solve the murders.

[b]Remember to wishlist this on Steam, to appease the algorithm daemons.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/2ac6dad24e44a89eee7d7daada9e58b4ba53e789.png[/img]

At the Church of Kitfox, most recently much of our efforts have gone into the completion of the first and second mystery case. Specific musical tracks for each witness during their testimonies have been created. There have been many improvements to the exorcism systems and environment, including the addition of futuristic tech props, overgrown vegetation (to make structures blend more), and footprints. Yes, characters will now have muddy footprints when the rain starts, which will be useful if one of them should commit a murder...

Day and night cycles are also being worked on, which [url=https://twitter.com/KitfoxGames/status/1189241084758708224]you can peep at here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216648/f4c272f5884f777be4a388b4939e7dd95d278273.jpg[/img]

If not, we shall connect in the digital sphere of [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Discord[/url], [url=http://www.twitter.com/kitfoxgames]Twitter[/url], or our [url=http://eepurl.com/RL5cP]newsletter[/url], for more specific updates.

Praise,

Inquisitor Victoria and the Church of Kitfox
